scope_label: planned comparison of factor effects on a response
definition: Design of experiments (DOE) is the planned variation of input factors to learn how they affect a specified response.
explanation: An experimental design states the factors, their settings, the response to observe, and how runs will be compared. It can reveal interactions that a one-factor-at-a-time check may miss.
The design must fit the question and available resources. A pattern found in the tested conditions needs further support before it is assumed to hold under different conditions.
